card.name: Start of radiographic after and/or
card.fires_on: The start of the word radiographic or radiological (the piece 'radi'), right after 'and', 'or' or 'by' in lists of clinical findings. Also fires on a few similar adjective starts such as 'clinically' or 'Planetary'.

modes.label: radi- after clinical terms
modes.description: The first piece of radiographic/radiological following 'and/or', 'or', 'and' or 'by' beside clinical symptoms or signs.
modes.example: exacerbation of clinical symptoms and/or<< radi>>ographic evidence of CNS demyelinating

modes.label: Other adjective starts
modes.description: Rare cases where a similar adjective begins after a linking word, or a word is split partway.
modes.example: the family history and<< clinically>> evaluate patients for motor or verbal tics

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the word as an imaging term (radiographic, radiological) and not media-related words.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text says 'clinical and/or radiographic' and the imaging word is about to be completed.
